Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Rustic Stoneware Crosshatch Indoor Flower Plant Pot, 6.25"H, Silver, Medium Planter
Colors: Silver
Materials: Stoneware
With or without a plant, this pot will add class and sophistication to any room. The exterior is white with an electroplated silver finish, and the interior is a darker grey. This piece will bridge modern and classic styles in your home. Clean, simple design and neutral colors will blend anywhere Planter is 100% stoneware with electroplated silver finish 7" Diameter x 6.25" High Durable stoneware pot great for display or holding a plant
